data.description: Per sequence/sidebar-fold-tickets.md §T3. Rename the Sourcing pipeline surface to Outreach (nav rename lands with MRQ-203; this ticket owns page title, breadcrumb, copy — no baked-in years anywhere, grep-able). Schema: outreach cards gain target_event_id (nullable for legacy rows); cards render '→ <conference>'; org-level placement stands (one funnel can aim at two conferences — demonstrated in the signed prototype seed). Card hygiene: name truncates with full-name tooltip, target line truncates, stage selector never escapes the card (von-Habsburg-length fixture in tests); button reads '+ Add prospect'. Person drawer shows outreach status when a live card exists: 'Outreach: <stage> → <target> · Open board' linking to the funnel. Also ruled in at the love pass (demonstrated in prototypes/crm v1.15 org-concept): next-touch dates with overdue tint and sort; do-not-contact (drawer toggle + compose exclusion that names excluded people); Export CSV beside Import. Design contract: prototypes/crm/index.html.

MERGE CAPTAIN RULING (durable record, 2026-08-14 ~18:00 ET). (1) MIGRATION NUMBER: MRQ-205 must rename migrations/0017_outreach_targeting.sql -> 0019_outreach_targeting.sql (file + its import line in tests/integration/apply-migrations.ts). 0017 belongs to MRQ-207 (org_settings), 0018 to MRQ-204 (event_deletion). Collision arose because no migration number was allocated to MRQ-205 originally — Merge Captain's oversight. (2) FK COUNTER: MRQ-205 MUST restore its scripts/schema-verify.mjs edit assert.equal(foreignKeyRows.length, 106). The shared-check standing rule bans changing check LOGIC, NOT updating an exact-count assertion that tracks schema — that counter must move in the SAME commit as the migration adding the edge, or main goes red between merges. Do not split it into a separate PR. (3) CUMULATIVE ARITHMETIC — main=105 FKs; MRQ-205 adds +1 (target_event_id->events); MRQ-207 adds +2 (invite_event_id->events, invite_org_id->organizations). Both PRs edit the SAME LINE off base 105. Whoever merges SECOND must set the CUMULATIVE value 108, never 106 or 107. Recompute from merged base + own delta; never resolve by taking either literal number.
